gameplay_loops.label: Nutrient Enrichment Cycle
gameplay_loops.summary: Hydroponics Specialists and Head Botanists work together to improve soil health, which eventually increases crop yield and stabilizes train speed.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Soil fertility is currently low, limiting the train's long-term sustainability.

gameplay_loops.label: Bio-fuel Optimization
gameplay_loops.summary: Bio-Engineers and Fuel Technicians convert crop yields into fuel to increase engine output, directly impacting train speed.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Engine output is insufficient to meet the Conductors Guild's speed requirements.

gameplay_loops.label: Labor Negotiation
gameplay_loops.summary: Council Liaisons and Commuter Representatives negotiate workload and speed limits to maintain passenger cooperation.
gameplay_loops.pressure: High-velocity vibrations are decreasing labor efficiency and threatening a strike.

player_entry_points: The Commuter Lounge during a scheduled shift change.
The Maintenance Yard after a reported engine vibration spike.
The Seed Archive when a new, rare specimen is discovered.
The Council Chamber during a budget allocation hearing.
conflict_hooks: The train speed is causing structural damage, but the Conductors Guild refuses to slow down until crop yields increase.
The Botany Bureau is hoarding rare seeds, preventing the Fuel Technician from creating the biofuel needed to maintain the train's current velocity.
Commuters are staging a sit-in at the Throttle Control Hub to protest the vibration levels caused by the current engine output.

agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: The Verdant Express utilizes a bioluminescent brass-punk aesthetic. Attire is functional, utilitarian, and integrated with organic elements. Characters wear heavy-duty workwear modified with brass fittings, mycelium-infused fabrics, and protective gear suitable for a living, vibrating train environment.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: Dominant deep greens with brass trim.
Dark forest greens with bioluminescent accents.
Rusted iron and dark mahogany tones.

default_rule.palette_notes: Muted earth tones with subtle green highlights.

visual_consistency_rules: All characters must have a thick, dark, high-contrast ink-line outline.
Use a strict top-down perspective for all sprite assets.
Ensure all tools and props are oversized for readability at 64x64.
Incorporate glowing mycelium elements on all character clothing.
Avoid complex shading; prioritize flat color blocks with sharp highlights.
Maintain a stout, functional body proportion for all roles.

visual_canon.lighting: Ambient bioluminescent glow from flora, sharp directional steam-vent highlights, no global sun.

terrain.ground: metallic floor grating with mossy gaps
